(1) LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton LVMUY: This is a $169 a share European fashion company, headquartered in Paris, France, with a market cap of $423.6B. I see a Zacks Value score of F, a Zacks Growth score of A and a Zacks Momentum score of A.  
  
(2) Alibaba BABA: This is $117 a share Mainland China tech stalwart, with a market cap of $308.7B. I see a Zacks Value score of C, a Zacks Growth score of D and a Zacks Momentum score of C. [...] In the Global Week Ahead, some of the biggest tech names in the U.S. report results.  
  
At the same time, the U.S. federal government will hit its debt limit.  
  
Surprising some across the Atlantic, Britain's FTSE100 share index flirts with a record high.  
  
In Asia, Japan, New Zealand and Australia release consumer price inflation (CPI) data. [...] On Monday, the Chicago Fed National Activity Index for DEC comes out. The prior reading was -0.05.  
  
On Tuesday, Japan's Jibun Bank manufacturing PMI comes out for JAN. The consensus is for 48.9, while prior DEC reading was 48.9.  
  
The Euro Area manufacturing PMI comes out. The JAN reading consensus is for 48.1, after a 47.8 print in DEC.  
  
On Wednesday, Australia's CPI should be +7.2% y/y. Their trimmed mean CPI should be +6.7% y/y.

## Final Thoughts

The week ahead could mark a key shift for markets as Big Tech earnings, housing data, and global tensions converge. Tesla, Google, and Intel will offer insight into tech sector strength, while weak housing numbers may highlight ongoing economic strain. With Bitcoin volatility rising and tariff threats looming, investors should brace for potential market swings that could set the tone for the rest of Q3.

# The Week Ahead: Big Tech Earnings and Housing Data Could Shift Sentiment

Technology companies including Tesla and Google report earnings while housing data reveals ongoing market challenges from high rates.

By Trader Edge4 Mins Read

## TLDR

Monday: Verizon (VZ) and Welltower (WELL)
 Tuesday: Visa (V), Coca-Cola (KO), Seagate (STX), Boeing (BA), S&P Global (SPGI) and HCA Healthcare (HCA)
 Wednesday: Alphabet (GOOGL), Microsoft (MSFT), GE Vernova (GEV), KLA (KLAC), Amphenol (APH), T-Mobile (TMUS), ServiceNow (NOW), ADP (ADP) and Phillips 66 (PSX) [...] DB says they saw global CTA positioning as having declined to the 62nd percentile to 2010 from the 66th the prior week (but down from the 89th six weeks ago), but they see positioning remaining relatively full in the S&P 500 at the 87th percentile. The Russell 2000 though is at just the 30th percentile, while the Nasdaq-100 fell to the 66th.

Looking at vol control\ positioning, with the increased volatility DB saw a healthy drop to the 81st percentile since 2010 from the 98th the prior week [...] Under the hood, global stock breadth now reads bearish at the 27th percentile, while equity flow jumped to very bullish at the 83rd. Fund-manager positioning is still at the 100th percentile.
